items: Launched on October 11, 2014, by the Ministry of Rural Development, aims to accelerate rural
development and make villages self-sufficient. Under the scheme, each Member of Parliament (MP)
is tasked with selecting 3 villages (1 by 2016, 2 by 2019, and 5 more by 2024) for comprehensive
development. MPs can choose villages within their constituency (Lok Sabha), state (Rajya Sabha), or
Economic empowerment through skill development and entrepreneurship.
